record.material_as_written: 0.35 M LiTFSI in PEGMA/BEMA w/w 3:7 with 2-4 wt% photoinitiator (sample 5)
record.evidence_quote: with σ = 7.9 · 10−6 S/cm was selected as a suitable
record.notes: Sample 5 is identified in the text as 0.35 M LiTFSI in PEGMA/BEMA w/w 3:7 with 2-4 wt% photoinitiator. The value is the bulk resistance-derived conductivity from impedance spectroscopy in a stainless steel cell. Other sample values in the text (2.8e-6 for samples 3/4, 2.1e-5 for sample 7) are a range without clear composition mapping, so they were not recorded. The main-text Dδ values are diffusion coefficients, not conductivities.
